## Advanced Usage: Unzipping Files Programmatically

For developers who need to integrate ZIP extraction functionality into their applications, our robust [Aspose.ZIP Universal Extractor for .NET](https://products.aspose.net/zip/universal-extractor/) offers a powerful solution. This standalone library not only supports basic extraction but also provides advanced control over the unzipping process.

### Developer's Guide to Unzipping with Aspose.ZIP

Follow these steps to unzip files programmatically in your .NET application:

1. **Install Aspose.ZIP for .NET:**  
   Download the library from [here](https://releases.aspose.com/zip/net/) or install it via NuGet:

   ```shell
   PM> Install-Package Aspose.ZIP
   ```

2. **Implement the Extraction Code:**  
   Use the following C# code to open a ZIP file and extract its contents to a designated directory:

   ```cs
   // Open ZIP file
   using (FileStream zipFile = File.Open("compressed_files.zip", FileMode.Open))
   {
       using (var archive = new Archive(zipFile))
       {
           // Unzip files to folder
           archive.ExtractToDirectory("Unzipped Files");
       }
   }
   ```

This simple snippet demonstrates how you can integrate unzipping capabilities into your own software. For more detailed instructions, visit our complete article on [how to extract ZIP files programmatically](https://blog.aspose.net/zip/extract-nested-zip-csharp/).
